correctness.rationale: For A=lambda P of rank k and f(0)=0, f(lambda)=a>0, Gaussian projection onto range(P) reduces full-sketch FlexTrace exactly to the same estimator on k-dimensional a I_k. At m=k, leave-one-out basics T_i=a(k-1+R_i), R_i chi-square(1). Conditioning on all except i,j leaves independent two-dimensional Gaussian vectors; shared sin² angle has second moment 3/8, E[R_i R_j]=3/2 and covariance 1/2. Therefore Var(mean)=a²(k+3)/(2k), expected dispersion proxy=3a²/(2k), corr=1/4; at k+1 probes Nyström exactness is a.s. For k=2, chi-square(4) times independent arcsine beta angle yields Laplace (s+2)/(2(1+s)^(3/2)), i.e. half chi1²/2 plus half chi3²/2. This proves the stated exact scope, not practical normalized probe accuracy.
residual_risks: Model restricted to unnormalized Gaussian columns and flat spectrum; mean proxy is not a high-probability confidence interval
